structured_output.what_is_happening: A '💲SATAN' token launched directly on a PumpSwap pool about 2 hours ago (not on the pump.fun curve, and the contract address has no 'pump' suffix). It rose +433% in 6h and +100% in 1h, to about $122k market cap with about $103k in the pool. The creator wallet holds 41.89% of supply outside the pool. GMGN tags 100 wallets as bundlers, who control about 45% of the top-trader share. The packet lists three earlier tokens with the identical name and ticker '💲SATAN', launched about 22h, 21h and 13h ago. All three now show zero liquidity and zero volume. The creator's best-token ATH of about $212k closely matches the first clone's roughly $214k market cap. This looks like a serial launch-and-pull template. I found no socials, website or web discussion of this token.

narrative.description: Generic 'SATAN' meme with no event, community or socials attached.
narrative.why_spreading: The flow looks driven by bundlers and bots (100 bundler wallets, only about 100 unique buyers per hour against 3.4k buys), not by any narrative.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only live pair among several identical '💲SATAN' deployments. The earlier ones are dead with zero liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 7WCR6Vw…, F6jP4c…, 9Hjrn… (same ticker, all rugged or at zero liquidity) and 3nV8x…pump 'Satan' (dead).

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 100 bundler wallets holding about 45% of the top-trader share. The creator holds 41.89%. Only about 100 unique buyers and sellers per hour against more than 3,000 buys, a pattern typical of bot volume. Three identical-name predecessors all ended at zero liquidity.
authenticity.uncertainty: The creator wallet differs from the earlier ones (launched count = 1), so the link rests on the matching template and ATH figure, not on confirmed on-chain funding links.

structural_risks: The creator holds 41.89% outside the pool, so it can dump into $103k of liquidity at any time.
LP burn ratio is 0, and RugCheck reports $0 total market liquidity, which contradicts the '100% locked' flag.
The same-name clones were all rugged within hours.
The earlier clone peaked near $214k. A 2x from $122k would need about $245k, above that prior ceiling.

structured_output.counterargument: Momentum is extreme (+100% in 1h, 5-minute rate holding steady versus the hourly rate). The buy/sell ratio stays positive, and holders reached about 1,100 in 2h. Operators sometimes pump a clone past the previous ATH before pulling, so a quick 2x wick is possible.
unknowns: Whether the creator wallet is funded by the same deployer as the earlier clones.
Actual LP ownership and lock status.
